description: Defines the SensorInputMapper class for handling sensor input mapping, including sensor configuration, processing, and axis management within the Android input system.

classes.name: SensorInputMapper
classes.description: Handles sensor input mapping, configuration, and processing for input devices.

classes.name: Sensor
classes.description: Represents individual sensor state and configuration.

classes.name: Axis
classes.description: Represents axis information and normalization parameters.

methods.name: getSources
methods.description: Returns input sources supported by this mapper.

methods.name: populateDeviceInfo
methods.description: Fills device info with sensor-related details.

methods.name: reconfigure
methods.description: Reconfigures the input mapper based on new settings.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the sensor input mapper state.

methods.name: enableSensor
methods.description: Enables a specific sensor with given sampling parameters.

methods.name: createAxis
methods.description: Creates an axis object with normalization parameters.

methods.name: parseSensorConfiguration
methods.description: Configures sensor parameters based on device info.

methods.name: createSensor
methods.description: Creates a sensor object for a given sensor type and axis.
